changes: Implemented LLM usage ledger Slice 5 — a READ-ONLY diagnostics/report layer, STRICTLY in-module (per user direction: keep the token module modular, do not modify other logic code). New core/usage-ledger/diagnostics.ts: grouped aggregation rolling up canonical token dims by storyId/phase/agentType(role)/model/provider (reusing summary.ts selectLatestRecords — no re-implementation), keeping provider-reported/estimate/unavailable separate, unknown stays unknown (never 0), superseded + estimates excluded from provider-reported totals; a pure cost projection from an INJECTED price table (DerivedCost discriminated union; null/unknown never 0; missing-model fail-safe; pricingRef recorded; only numeric constant is TOKENS_PER_MILLION=1e6, no hardcoded prices); buildUsageReport assembling overall totals, per-group breakdowns, counts, unknown count, optional cost — feeds NO gate. New tasks/usage-ledger-report.ts: a runnable reporter (reads a ledger JSONL path + optional price-table, prints human + --json), wired as an npm script, NOT a registered lattice CLI command. Diff touches only the 4 files (diagnostics + report task + smoke + package.json); zero changes to dispatch/cli-engine/handlers/command-registry; usage-ledger module still imports zero other Lattice modules. Added usage-ledger-diagnostics-smoke.ts (34 checks) wired as npm test:usage-ledger-diagnostics.
usage: Run the reporter over a ledger file to read per-story/per-model/per-role token usage (and optional cost if you pass a price table): npm --prefix packages/main run usage-ledger-report -- <ledger.jsonl> [priceTable.json] (or via LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER_PATH / LATTICE_USAGE_PRICE_TABLE). Read-only; feeds no gate. Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:usage-ledger-diagnostics to see all 34 checks pass.
expectedOutcome: npm run test:usage-ledger-diagnostics all-green and the reporter task prints a grouped report (totals by source, per-group breakdowns by story/model/role/provider, counts, unknown count, optional injected-price cost). unknown stays unknown (never 0); estimates/superseded excluded from provider totals; no hardcoded prices; report feeds no gate. Build clean; only the 4 in-module files changed; zero cross-module imports.

limitations: Read-only diagnostics only. Reporter is a runnable task over a ledger file, NOT a first-class lattice CLI command (registering one would touch the command registry / other logic, which the user forbade). The ledger still records nothing from real runs until the dispatch-wiring slice; this reports over whatever ledger file exists. Cost requires an injected price table. No budget enforcement, no receipt path, no default-on.
pitfalls: Keep diagnostics read-only and feeding no gate. Cost must stay injected-price-table only — never hardcode prices. unknown/unavailable must never become 0 (DerivedCost/known-bucket guards enforce this). Note: groupKeyString uses a NUL-byte sentinel to distinguish a null storyId from the string null, which makes git treat diagnostics.ts as binary — deliberate and sound. To make the reporter a first-class CLI command later, that is a separate story that touches the command registry.
